title: The Pulse: Firebase’s global outage & poor response
author: Ivan Klaric
description: The Firebase iOS SDK crashed after a backend change, crashing all apps which used Firebase analytics for 2-6 hours. Google didn’t update the status page, but did offer a postmortem 4 days later.
summary: Hi, this is Gergely with a bonus, free issue of the Pragmatic Engineer Newsletter. In every issue, I cover Big Tech and startups through the lens of senior engineers and engineering leaders.
takeaways: Source: GitHub It’s unclear if the Firebase team was alerted via this ticket with 100+ comments by devs, or if Google’s own monitoring tool showed the issue.
